Between [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] and [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]] during the invasion of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong galaxy|extra-galactic]] [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], which became known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' pp. XIII</ref> the Vong attacked the [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi system]] within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> By this time, the system was home to the strategic [[Bilbringi Shipyards]] that were constructing hundreds of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] for the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="SbS" /> The attack took place in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] and the Vong reached the [[Star system/Legends|system]] by traveling down the [[Namadii Corridor/Legends|Namadii Corridor]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] from a previous [[Battle near Vortex|battle]] in the [[Ten Tempests system|Vortex system]]. After the attack the Vong continued down the same hyperlane and [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; First)|attacked]] the [[Pyria system|Borleias system]].<ref name="TEA" /> Two years later, the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] and [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] attempted to reclaim the Bilbringi system in a combined attack known as [[Second Battle of Bilbringi|Operation Trinity]]. However, the operation failed, due to the Vong bringing down the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] relay stations and preventing the coordination of the attack.<ref name="Final">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the Bilbringi system was first mentioned in [[The New Jedi Order: The Final Prophecy|''The Final Prophecy'']] when the Galactic Alliance attempted to reclaim Bilbringi. The exact dating of the capture of Bilbringi by the Vong was not stated in the books of the [[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order|New Jedi Order series]]. In ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book released in [[2009]] and written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], the attack is not mentioned in the text of the book but is shown on a map detailing conflicts. The reference book put this attack between the attack on [[Vortex/Legends|Vortex]] and [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]] that both appeared in [[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star|''Star by Star'']]. Thus the attack on the Bilbringi system must occur during the event of ''Star by Star'', in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] (62:4).
